zh.title: 宿霧太平洋航空接收今年第六架新機 A320neo 自天津飛抵馬尼拉
zh.summary: 宿霧太平洋航空於11月19日接收一架 A320neo，為今年第四架同型新機。
body: 菲律賓宿霧太平洋航空11月19日接收一架空中巴士 A320neo。據 AeroTime 報導，客機從空中巴士天津總裝廠飛往馬尼拉，是該公司今年接收的第六架新機，也是今年第四架 A320neo。
這次交付是在11月8日接收一架 A321neo 之後。先前抵達的 A321neo 為公司成立30週年的紀念彩繪機。
宿霧太平洋航空表示，新機有助於因應耶誕與年末旅遊旺季的旅運需求。據報導，公司預計今年共接收七架空中巴士 neo 系列客機。

en.title: Cebu Pacific takes delivery of its sixth aircraft of 2026, an Airbus A320neo
en.summary: The A320neo flew from Airbus’s Tianjin assembly facility to Manila ahead of the holiday travel season.
body: Cebu Pacific took delivery of an Airbus A320neo on November 19. The aircraft flew from Airbus’s Tianjin final assembly facility to Manila, AeroTime reported. It was the carrier’s sixth new aircraft of the year and its fourth A320neo delivery in 2026.
It follows the arrival of an A321neo on November 8, which carried a special livery marking the Philippine airline’s 30th anniversary.
Cebu Pacific said the additional aircraft will help it accommodate demand during the peak Christmas travel season. The carrier expects to receive seven Airbus neo family aircraft during 2026.

facts.claim: The A320neo delivered on November 19 flew to Manila from Tianjin.
It is the sixth new aircraft and fourth A320neo delivered to Cebu Pacific in 2026.
Cebu Pacific expects seven neo aircraft deliveries in 2026.
